name: Mateo Vargas Quispe
bio:
Mateo's journey into motorsport began with a fascination for vehicle mechanics, nurtured in his father's auto repair shop in Lima. Initially drawn to the intricate workings of engines, Mateo quickly realized his organizational skills were better suited for ensuring everything ran smoothly behind the scenes. He started volunteering at local karting events, coordinating transportation and equipment. His meticulous approach and ability to anticipate problems caught the attention of Reiza Racing Academy.

At Reiza, Mateo thrives on the challenge of managing complex logistical puzzles, from coordinating international shipments of parts to ensuring the pit crew has everything they need at a moment's notice. He believes a proactive and data-driven approach is crucial for success, constantly seeking ways to optimize processes and minimize potential disruptions. What sets Mateo apart is his uncanny ability to remember the precise location of every item in the team's inventory, a skill that has saved the team countless times during crucial moments.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed, with a slight wave
physical.description: Mateo is of average height with a wiry build and an intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with logistical schematics.
Insists on organizing the team's snack supplies alphabetically.
Has a lucky Pachamanca stone he keeps on his desk for good luck.
